text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm on a walk with Daiwa Scarlet<n>when we spot
Aston Machan taking<n>photos of... a blouse? Laid out
on a<n>bench...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, here comes a nice<n>breeze—perfect timing for a
fluttery<n>photo.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Um, mind if I ask why you're taking<n>so many
photos of a blouse?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Today's her last huzzah, so I was<n>hoping to send
her off in style before<n>retiring her from my
wardrobe.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Before... retiring her? ...Oh! There's a<n>stain on the
sleeve.
choice_data_list:
Yikes... A stain like that's probably not gonna come
out...

Yikes... A stain like that's probably not gonna come
out...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I won't be able to wear her anymore,<n>so the time
has come to say goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But... But...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You love that blouse, don't you? You<n>wore it out all
the time.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, and I've got so many beautiful<n>photos of our
time together to look<n>back on.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well, sure, but still... Are you really<n>getting rid of it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You'd keep wearing it if you could,<n>right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Let me have a go at the stain! I'll see<n>if there's
anything I can do to bring<n>the blouse back, okay?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Scarlet...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I've been patting the stain<n>with a
toothbrush, but I can't tell if<n>it's doing anything.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
This method must be for fresher<n>stains... I'll try
something else!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Ooh, washing it with an<n>oil-based
cleanser might do the trick!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet tries every method she<n>can find, but
the stain refuses to go.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Urgh, why isn't anything working?! I<n>guess I'll
have to try asking<n>Hishiama if she knows any other
tricks...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Scarlet, it's okay. You've done<n>enough.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This blouse had a good run, but<n>everyone has to
cross the finish<n>eventually. Now, it's time for her to
rest.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Machan...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But... There's got to be something wecan do! You wouldn't just give uprunning 'cause you lost someraces—you'd keep trying until youmake it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Make... it... That's it! We could make<n>it... into
something new!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You've got all those Machan dolls.<n>Could you bring
one here?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With Machan's permission, Scarlet<n>cuts up the
blouse and starts<n>resewing the pieces into a tiny
replica<n>for Mini Machan.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Just you watch—I'll breathe new life<n>into it, I swear!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Wow, it fits Mini Machan perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I hope you like it!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It feels like watching one sun set and<n>a new sun
rise. The sky's different,<n>but the sunlight... The
sunlight feels<n>the same.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Should I be saying hello? Or welcome<n>back?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I think... I'd just say, "I'm glad<n>you're still here."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You've been together for so long, and<n>you're
gonna stay together even<n>longer!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh. That's nice... I agree—I'm glad<n>we're still
together.
choice_data_list: You really worked some magic making this, Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, just look at this smile. Her<n>cuteness is off the
charts.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You think? Hehe! Should we put some<n>pics of her
on Umasta? Who knows,<n>she might go viral. ♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You don't say... Machan—at the very<n>top of the
trends. Why, we've got to<n>hold a strategy meeting
right away.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This will be a big step forward in the<n>Machan
Marketing campaign, so I'd<n>greatly appreciate it if
you could get a<n>head start on making more blouses.
They're going to be flying off the<n>shelves.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Geez, you don't miss a beat, do you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I guess the first order of business is<n>deciding how
we'll source the<n>materials!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the rescued blouse as<n>inspiration, the pair start
sketching out<n>ideas for its bright new future as a
fashion icon!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it was nothing. I've always<n>taken care of my
own clothes.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
My parents both have busy<n>schedules, so I've
been mending and<n>making things since I was little.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Then it's not "nothing"—it's years of<n>experience.
You're very skilled,<n>Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, oh gosh. I'm just glad my<n>sewing came in
handy here!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It really makes all the trial and error I<n>went through
feel worth it.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet gazes lovingly at the Machan<n>Doll, then
happily tells us about all the<n>things she sewed as a
kid.
